Ecosystem #

The regional ecosystem covering environmental management, technology, education, social services, and regional development is diverse in scope, focus, and approach; a sample of that ecosystem follows.

E-waste management #

Entity Potential Relationship
Tairāwhiti Environment Centre (TEC)
  • Saved can be a local partner demonstrating reuse, repurpose, and revival at scale
  • Saved can help TEC manage the insurmountable amount of devices coming their way
TechCollect NZ (with Noel Leeming)
  • Saved can be a local redirection for the TechCollect NZ scheme, keeping useful laptops in-region
Recycle A Device
  • Saved can provide surplus devices to volunteer refurbishment schemes such as Recycle A Device

IT retailers and IT services #

Entity Potential Relationship
Noel Leeming, Harvey Norman et al
  • Saved will offer low-cost open laptop alternatives for people who cannot reasonably afford to buy new
Business Applications, Fusion Networks, Mytronics et al
  • Saved can be a future support partner focused on alternative ways of working

IT capability building and education #

Entity Potential Relationship
Tōnui Collab
  • Saved can be a complementary provider of tertiary qualification pathways in resilient technologies
Rāngai
  • Saved can be a complementary provider of tertiary qualification pathways in resilient technologies
TaiTech
  • Saved can be a complementary partner and provider of laptops and workshops on cost-effective and resilient computing
Digital Futures Aotearoa, Remojo Tech
  • Saved can be a local collaborator
EIT
  • A potential accreditation and delivery partner for qualifications in resilient technologies
  • Saved can be a regular intern sponsor
Te Wānanga o Aotearoa, Tūranga Ararau, and PTEs
  • Saved can be a complementary partner and provider of laptops and workshops on cost-effective and resilient computing
Local high schools
  • Saved could become a laptop provider to high schools, though this is not anticipated outside of alternative education providers
  • Saved can be a provider of workshops at secondary level on resilient technologies

Entity Potential Relationship
